title: Spark
summary_html: Spark is the son of murdered Trinsic blacksmith Christopher in Ultima VII, and a potential party member in the game. He is one of the youngest companions to accompany the Avatar, claiming to be fourteen years of age when the Avatar first meets him.[1]
